desc: Hunters should never have to sacrifice precision or performance simply because they choose to bring a handgun into the field. Now, longer range, better expansion, deeper penetration and superior accuracy are all within reach with Terminal Ascent Handgun. The loads use a bonded bullet design to increase weight retention, while a unique, elastomer-filled nose cavity expands reliably on a variety of game. The nickel-plated case and bullet, along with the sealed primer prevent corrosion and ensure flawless reliability in all conditions.
